notes.subject: ⟨a⟩
notes.rationale: Bamanankan bɛ nɔnabila dɔ wajibi ka bɔŋ-sira falen dɔn; Heburukan ma a fɔ

notes.subject: fara a kan
notes.rationale: יסיף kɔrɔ ye 'ka fara ɲɔgɔn kan' ye; n'a bɛ fɔ Bamanankan na o kɔrɔ 'ka kɛ tɔgɔda', kumafila in na a fɔra daɲɛ yɛrɛ la

notes.subject: הלעולמים
notes.rationale: Siya-camancogo (plural) 'wolokolow' — Heburukan bɛ 'le-olamim' fɔ ni caman-cogo ye; Bamanankan 'bɛɛ la' ye o siya jira

notes.subject: Adonay
notes.rationale: Kumasen in ye ɲinini ye min bɛ Adonay bolo kokura — kalandenba min siran don, o de b'a fɔ

translation: Yaa wolokolow bɛɛ la, Adonay bɛna ⟨a⟩ bɔŋ wa, ani a tɛ fara a kan ka don ni-yɛrɛ la kokura?
